x_thread: Stripe vs Paddle, explained in 5 tweets:
Stripe is a payment processor. You're the seller, so registering and filing sales tax/VAT is on you.
Paddle is a merchant of record. It's legally the seller, collects the tax, files it, pays you the rest.
MoR fees are higher, but the cross-border tax work leaves your desk.
Rule of thumb: software sold in many countries → MoR. One country, services, custom billing → Stripe. Not tax advice.
